c: On any active incident, open More actions and choose Create new communication. Incident, major incident and communication managers see it.
say: On any active incident, open more actions and choose create new communication. Incident managers, major incident managers and communication managers see it.

c: Fill Short description, choose Now or Later, One time or Recurring, and Due in (minutes).
say: Write a short description, choose now or later, one time or recurring, and when it is due.

c: Pick the email channel and add people or groups under Recipients.
say: Pick email as the channel, and add people or groups as recipients. Text messages are switched off on pdi2.

c: Compose communication opens the email to write; Save adds it to the Upcoming section.
say: Compose communication opens the email for you to write and send. Save keeps it for later, in the upcoming section.

c: The plan appears under Related records › Incident Communication Plans.
say: The plan appears in the related records tab, under incident communication plans. Every support agent can see it.

c: The task's assignee is emailed when it is due and when it is overdue. Set Assigned to on an ordinary incident.
say: The task's assignee is emailed when the next update is due, and when it is overdue. On an ordinary incident, set the assignee yourself.
